definitions.explanation: The two branches of the windpipe that carry air into the lungs, and their smaller branches. Common in talk about coughs, colds and asthma.

examples.japanese: {気管支|きかんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こじらせて→こじらせる：22115_kojiraseru⟧⟦{気管支炎|きかんしえん}→気管支炎：27056_kikanshien⟧になった。
examples.english: My cold got worse and turned into bronchitis.
